notes.title: The Mirror Dimension Teaser Released!
notes.notes:
Get ready for a mysterious journey into infinity! "[b]The Mirror Dimension[/b]" will pull you into the depths of a suspenseful and frightening parallel universe. In this dimension, which is a dark reflection beyond the ordinary world, reality and nightmares intertwine.

[b]The Mirror Dimension[/b] will take you to a nightmare world even more dangerous than the real one. Test your survival skills as you face enemies and solve puzzles. Uncover the secrets of The Mirror Dimension by solving mysteries around you, traversing between dimensions, and making decisions that will alter reality.

We are delighted to present the first teaser of [b]The Mirror Dimension[/b] to you.

[previewyoutube=RfkOX2UGRbU;full][/previewyoutube]

The second teaser for [b]The Mirror Dimension[/b] will be released just before Next Fest in February.

Stay tuned!
